wiki.title: Robyn Vining
wiki.extract: Robyn Beckley Vining (born November 11, 1976) is an American photographer, nonprofit executive, and Democratic politician from Wauwatosa, Wisconsin. She is a member of the Wisconsin State Assembly, representing Wisconsin's 13th Assembly district since 2025; she previously represented the 14th Assembly district from 2019 to 2025.
